responsibility: This definition module declares the low-level runtime exception handling API used by GNU Modula-2 and the compiler-generated checks. It introduces the opaque EHBlock type, handler registration and removal, exception raising and block switching, accessors for the current exception number and message buffer, exception-state control, default catch/throw configuration, and source tracking, forming the core system-module interface between generated code, language exceptions, and runtime control flow.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the system-facing API declaration for the RTExceptions pair: it exposes the opaque EHBlock type and exception-control entry points used by generated code, while RTExceptions.mod supplies the handler tables, active-block state, message-buffer formatting, and default raiser hookups.
